text: Program Description The Foundation Program is designed to enhance students’ English proficiency and their abilities in mathematics, physics, chemistry, and biology, and to help them better adapt to university life, thereby improving their chances of passing the entrance examination. Main subjects: English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology. Students who achieve satisfactory results upon completion of the program may proceed to the English-medium undergraduate programs at HUST. Duration Duration: 17 weeks Intake: March 1 – June 25, 2027
